About the job

Define how Graphcore tests complex hardware before it reaches production and the field.

As Principal Board Test Engineer, you will lead advanced manufacturing test strategy for complex Circuit Board Assemblies. You will shape how Graphcore improves defect coverage, diagnostic resolution and production quality.

Your work will influence products, test architectures and manufacturing partners. You will define methods, evaluation criteria and technical approaches that help PTD move faster with confidence.

The Team and Culture

The Product Test and Diagnosis team detects, diagnoses and manages hardware defects across chips, boards and full systems. The team works close to design, manufacturing, silicon, software and systems engineering.

Work moves through hands-on investigation, clear technical judgement and direct ownership. You will be expected to act fast, speak up and take responsibility for test strategy decisions.

Decisions are shaped by evidence, design intent and manufacturing reality. You will help the team think big, challenge assumptions and raise engineering standards across disciplines.

· Deep expertise in manufacturing test for advanced, high-complexity Circuit Board Assemblies.
· Strong knowledge of electronics fundamentals, CCA manufacturing processes and defect mechanisms.
· Expertise in JTAG 1149.x boundary scan, iJTAG and embedded or processor-controlled functional test.
· Experience architecting, programming and debugging bed-of-nails MDA/ICT and board-level test systems.
· Capability to define test methods, evaluation frameworks and technical criteria independently.
· Strong influence across engineering disciplines, suppliers and manufacturing partners.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.
